metadata.protocol: Five named controls plus four seeded modes for each admissible combination of 1..4 branches, interval/two-interval/two-hole resources and one/two distinct parents. Modes are two unconditioned difference draws, an internally pairable control and a constructed positive control. Inputs are fixed and saved before classification; outcomes are not used to select inputs. Exact duplicate resource problems are merged. This is neither exhaustive coverage of resource patterns nor a naturally sampled residual workload.
